name.sw: Mama na Mtoto

who.en:
Mama na Mtoto is the monthly box for a mother and her child from birth to the third birthday. It carries the everyday goods that keep a baby clean, dry, warm, protected from malaria and diarrhoea and learning through play, and the few things the mother needs for her own recovery and for breastfeeding. Pregnancy is served by a separate box, Mama Mjamzito, delivered once per trimester.

The first weeks carry the highest risk: in Tanzania about 24 of every 1,000 babies die in the first month, and only about half of mothers and newborns are checked within two days of birth (TDHS-MIS 2022). The box follows WHO’s 2022 recommendations on maternal and newborn care after birth: keep the baby warm and clean, breastfeed exclusively for six months, and give the mother iron and folic acid where anaemia is common. It adds a treated net and repellent because malaria remains the main reason a Tanzanian child’s fever needs the clinic the same day.

From six months the box follows WHO’s 2023 guideline on complementary feeding and WHO’s measures against diarrhoea: safe drinking water, handwashing with soap, and ORS with zinc at home. Every month brings one simple, cheap developmental toy, because early learning is one of the five parts of the WHO–UNICEF Nurturing Care Framework. Nappy counts follow the baby’s age and weight; every quantity has a stated formula and can be adjusted in the app.

The box contains no medicine. Iron and folic acid, ORS and zinc are listed so the family knows they are needed, but they are sold and explained by Afya’s licensed partner pharmacy. Food and infant milks are not in the box: they are chosen by the family from the separate nutrition shelf, within the WHO Code on breast-milk substitutes.
who.sw:
Mama na Mtoto ni sanduku la kila mwezi kwa mama na mtoto wake tangu kuzaliwa hadi siku ya kuzaliwa ya tatu. Lina bidhaa za kila siku zinazomweka mtoto safi, mkavu, mwenye joto, aliyekingwa dhidi ya malaria na kuharisha, na anayejifunza kupitia michezo, pamoja na vitu vichache ambavyo mama anahitaji kwa kupona kwake na kwa kunyonyesha. Ujauzito unahudumiwa na sanduku tofauti, Mama Mjamzito, linaloletwa mara moja kila miezi mitatu ya ujauzito.

Wiki za mwanzo zina hatari kubwa zaidi: Tanzania takriban watoto 24 kati ya kila 1,000 hufariki katika mwezi wa kwanza, na ni karibu nusu tu ya akina mama na watoto wachanga wanaochunguzwa ndani ya siku mbili baada ya kuzaliwa (TDHS-MIS 2022). Sanduku linafuata mapendekezo ya WHO ya mwaka 2022 kuhusu huduma kwa mama na mtoto mchanga baada ya kujifungua: mtoto awe na joto na safi, anyonyeshwe maziwa ya mama pekee kwa miezi sita, na mama apate vidonge vya chuma na foliki pale upungufu wa damu ni wa kawaida. Linaongeza chandarua chenye dawa na dawa ya kufukuza mbu kwa sababu malaria bado ndiyo sababu kuu ya homa ya mtoto wa Tanzania kuhitaji kliniki siku hiyo hiyo.

Kuanzia miezi sita sanduku linafuata mwongozo wa WHO wa mwaka 2023 kuhusu ulishaji wa nyongeza na hatua za WHO dhidi ya kuharisha: maji salama ya kunywa, kunawa mikono kwa sabuni, na ORS pamoja na zinki nyumbani. Kila mwezi huleta mchezo mmoja rahisi na wa bei nafuu unaosaidia makuzi, kwa sababu kujifunza mapema ni mojawapo ya nguzo tano za Mfumo wa Malezi Bora wa WHO na UNICEF. Idadi ya nepi hufuata umri na uzito wa mtoto; kila kiasi kina hesabu iliyoelezwa na kinaweza kubadilishwa kwenye programu.

Sanduku halina dawa. Vidonge vya chuma na foliki, ORS na zinki vimeorodheshwa ili familia ijue vinahitajika, lakini vinauzwa na kuelezwa na duka la dawa mshirika la Afya lenye leseni. Chakula na maziwa ya watoto hayamo kwenye sanduku: familia huchagua kutoka rafu tofauti ya lishe, kwa kufuata Kanuni ya WHO kuhusu vibadala vya maziwa ya mama.

clinic_line.en: Which medicines the mother or child take, at what dose, how often the baby is weighed and checked, and when to see a doctor are decided by your clinic. The box never replaces clinic visits or vaccinations; a fever in a baby under three months, or any danger sign, goes to the clinic the same day.
clinic_line.sw: Dawa ambazo mama au mtoto watatumia, kwa kipimo gani, mara ngapi mtoto apimwe uzito na kuchunguzwa, na wakati wa kumwona daktari huamuliwa na kliniki yako. Sanduku halichukui nafasi ya mahudhurio ya kliniki wala chanjo; homa kwa mtoto chini ya miezi mitatu, au dalili yoyote ya hatari, ipelekwe kliniki siku hiyo hiyo.
